entities.summary: Garry Montzell Gilliam Jr. is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle in the National Football League (NFL) for the Seattle Seahawks and San Francisco 49ers. He was signed as an undrafted free agent by the Seahawks after the 2014 NFL draft. He played college football for the Penn State Nittany Lions.
